source.title: Principle-Evolvable Scientific Discovery via Uncertainty Minimization

work_item.objective: Compare static and expanding principle-space equation discovery under matched budgets and sealed held-out evaluation.
work_item.falsifier: The reported benefit disappears under matched resources, sealed holdouts, independent scoring or complete failure/cost accounting.

focused_local_tests.scope: isolated focused harness; full repository CI not run locally

lanes.A: Adds a fail-closed metadata contract for incumbent assumption, alternative equation, physics checks, falsifier, held-out prediction, counterexamples, proof/simulation, experiment, independent validation, system consequence and economics. No algorithmic advantage established.
lanes.B: Provider-neutral/no-submit path preserved; no provider initialized and no QPU job submitted.
lanes.C: Memory, data movement and model-call resource costs are required in the future matched benchmark; no storage equivalence result.
lanes.D: No device/chip/process result; only a downstream consequence if an independently validated equation changes requirements.
lanes.E: No Pangola-carbon, accepted bio-oil, material substitution, cooling or net-fusion-electricity result.
lanes.F: Requires all failed runs, retries, compute/API cost, measured energy and cost per accepted formula under a single named cost basis.
lanes.G: D/G co-design preserved; no fabrication, yield or factory-economics result.
lanes.H: Official source and limits recorded; no funding, WACC or strategic-industrial result.
lanes.I: Auxiliary lane is unchanged and does not replace mandatory A-H.

foundational.FND-002: No new output-information or readable-memory lower bound.
foundational.FND-005: No new QFT/particle mechanism or discriminating anomaly.
foundational.FND-006: Principle-space expansion is a candidate-generation method only.
foundational.EQN-002: Known-law recovery and held-out/OOD scoring required.
foundational.EQN-003: Metadata gate added; no equation generator executed.
foundational.EQN-005: No new-physics escalation or law promotion.
foundational.EQN-006: Source-to-claim, proof/experiment, independent validation, system consequence and economics gates specified.

invariant_evaluation.INV-025_026_027: Preserved; no 100,000,000-unit replacement or Hilbert-space-to-readable-storage claim.
invariant_evaluation.INV-029: No Data-Center-to-One-Phone service, energy, physical compression or lifecycle-cost gate closed.
invariant_evaluation.INV-030: No functional Pangola-carbon substitution/recovery result and no transmutation claim.
invariant_evaluation.INV-031: No accepted bio-oil/fuel function or full cost-per-energy result.
invariant_evaluation.INV-032: No reliable net delivered fusion electricity or lifecycle-cost result.
invariant_evaluation.INV-033: No principal, absolute-interest, time-to-evidence or WACC effect measured.
invariant_evaluation.INV-034: Mathematics-first candidate generation remains active under present physical constraints.
invariant_evaluation.INV-035: The helper checks metadata completeness only and never promotes an AI-generated equation to physical law.
